newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends higher on late local rally.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends higher on late local rally.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was slightly higher at midday on local activity after a failed attempt by the trade to make a run at sell stops below the range.
The active October contract was 11.63 cents a lb at 1114 EDT, up 0.02 cents from Tuesday, in a range between 11.56 and 11.65 cents a lb.
"It was mostly local activity today," said one floor broker. "No major volumes. The trade were scale-up sellers.
"There's some stops built up below 11.50 cents (in October)," he added. "They tried for them today but they didn't make it."
The funds are believed to be long and on the sidelines.
